### Cineverse Brings Video Podcasts Bad Movies Rule!, Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr, and The Stand Presents: 10 for 10 to Amazon Fire TV


09/29/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/484194886/files/doc_news/Cineverse-Brings-Video-Podcasts-Bad-Movies-Rule-Mohr-Stories-with-Jay-Mohr-and-The-Stand-Presents-10-for-10-to-Amazon-Fire-TV-2026.pdf)


*Plus: Top Cineverse FAST Channels including The Dog Whisperer and The Bob Ross Channel Now Available on Fire TV Devices*


LOS ANGELES


, Sept. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Cineverse](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=4113326716&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cineverse.com%2F&a=Cineverse) (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced the launch of eight video podcasts on Amazon Fire TV. This marks the company's first major distribution of ad-supported video-on-demand (AVOD) podcasts (VODcasts), furthering its commitment to growing the Cineverse Podcast Network – including horror shows from Bloody FM and comedy from the WITZ Podcast Network.


Additionally, some of Cineverse's most popular free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels are also available via Fire TV.


Shows now available to all Amazon Fire TV customers – with no download, sign-ups, or fees – include:


- ***Bad Movies Rule!*** – A comedy podcast for people who love so-called bad movies - those that have been declared bad by critics or audiences to see if they really deserve to be on the trash pile or if they actually rule.
- ***Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr*** – hosted by comedian/actor and SNL alum Jay Mohr, featuring candid, often humorous interviews with celebrities, comics, and cultural figures. Discussions span careers, personal stories, and life in Hollywood, sometimes including in-depth, emotional, or nostalgic conversations.
- ***The Stand Comedy Club Presents: 10 for 10*** – 10 for 10 is The Stand Comedy Club's signature series celebrating a decade (and counting) of the club's raw, transformative impact on stand-up comedy. Hosted by the sharp and seasoned Kieran McCann, each episode dives deep with a standout comedian who calls The Stand home- unpacking the grind, the bombs, the breakthroughs, the green-room chaos, and the nights that changed everything. Past guests include Jim Gaffigan, Shane Gillis, Ari Shaffir, Janeane Garofalo, T.J. Miller and more!


"The trend toward video podcasts is well documented, with every major platform getting into the game, and Fire TV is the latest sign of our commitment to reaching audiences where and how they want to consume," said Tom Owen, Vice President, Networks Strategy. "According to[Sounds Profitable](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=2361528066&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsoundsprofitable.com%2Fresearch%2Fthe-creators-2025%2F&a=Sounds+Profitable) , 71% of podcast creators are producing video, and revenue for video podcasts is estimated to be 12x higher per year than for audio-only. We are embracing this reality and will continue to do so moving forward."


Additionally, customers can now instantly access these Cineverse FAST channels for free on Fire TV:


- **The Bob Ross Channel** – home to more than 400 episodes of *The Joy of Painting.*
- **Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan** – featuring all nine seasons and 160 episodes of the popular series.
- **GoPro Channel** – features exhilarating, first-person action sports content from across the globe.
- **HISTORIAN** – a variety of history-based programming, in partnership with American Public Television, where viewers can watch history unfold.
- **JoySauce TV** – dedicated to American Asian audiences.
- **Real Madrid TV** – comprehensive behind-the-scenes access to one of the world's most successful soccer clubs, delivering match highlights, exclusive interviews and documentaries.
- **Yu-Gi-Oh!** – features nearly 400 hours of episodes spanning iconic titles like *Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters* , *Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS* , and the movie *Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions* .


"We're thrilled to also be adding these FAST channels for Amazon Fire TV customers," added Cineverse Vice President of Partnerships Alexandra Viglione. "From established leaders in Dog Whisperer and Bob Ross, to new channels like HISTORIAN and JoySauce, fans of any IP or genre can find something they enjoy through Fire TV devices."


**About Cineverse Podcast Network**


Cineverse operates a top-10 podcast network with more than 35 audio series. It leverages owned-and-operated brands like Bloody Disgusting, Midnight Pulp and RetroCrush to deliver hit shows in horror, true crime


and entertainment, also recently expanding into comedy programming with the launch of WITZ Podcast Network in partnership with The Stand Group. A growing division of the Company, the Cineverse Podcast Network generates advertising revenue from brands across key categories, including movie studios, retailers and consumer products. Series include *Mayfair Watchers Society* (from the mind of *Siren Head* creator Trevor Henderson), *The Bloody Disgusting Podcast* (hosted by Zena Dixon and Shelby Novak), *Creepy Places* (a true crime


podcast hosted by Jon Grilz), *The Dead* (in partnership with The George A. Romero Foundation), *The Losers Club* (breaking down Stephen King's career chronologically), *Murder in America* (co-hosted by Courtney Shannon & Colin Browen), and more.


**About Cineverse Streaming**


Cineverse owns and/or operates a wide range of[premium streaming brands](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=4291235935&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cineverse.com%2Fchannels%2F&a=premium+streaming+brands) , from free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels to subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) apps. These span fandoms – from single IP channels around pop cultural icons such as[Bob Ross](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=4217737232&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbobrosschannel.com%2Fhome1%2F&a=Bob+Ross) and[The Dog Whisperer with Cesar Milan](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=2888815019&u=https%3A%2F%2Fstreaming.cineverse.com%2Flivetv%3Fq%3DDogWhisperer&a=The+Dog+Whisperer+with+Cesar+Milan) , to channels curated for fans of Horror ([Screambox](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=2493110386&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.screambox.com%2F&a=Screambox) ,[Midnight Pulp](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=3281227640&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.midnightpulp.com%2F&a=Midnight+Pulp) ), Anime and Pan-Asian shows and films ([RetroCrush](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=780356940&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.retrocrush.tv%2F&a=RetroCrush) ,[AsianCrush](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=2715879038&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.asiancrush.com%2F&a=AsianCrush) ), Comedy ([Gorilla Comedy+](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=3561228265&u=https%3A%2F%2Fgorillacomedyplus.com%2F&a=Gorilla+Comedy%2B) ), Independent Film ([Fandor](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=778054427&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fandor.com%2F&a=Fandor) ), Romance ([Dove Channel](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=3618831193&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dovechannel.com%2F&a=Dove+Channel) ) and True Crime


([Crime Hunters](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=327865635&u=https%3A%2F%2Fstreaming.cineverse.com%2Flivetv%3Fq%3DCrimeHunters&a=Crime+Hunters) ), to name a few.


**About Cineverse**


**Cineverse** (Nasdaq: CNVS) is an entertainment technology company and studio. Fiercely innovative and independent, Cineverse develops and invests in technology and content that drives the future of the industry. Core to its business is[Matchpoint®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=971669703&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.matchpoint.tv%2F&a=Matchpoint%C2%AE) – a growing tech ecosystem designed to prepare, distribute, monetize, and continuously improve content across any platform. Matchpoint helps studios large and small operate at scale and improve performance and efficiency in an increasingly fragmented distribution environment. Additionally, Cineverse distributes a vast library of premium films, series, and podcasts, across theatrical, home entertainment, and streaming; operates dozens of digital properties that super serve passionate fandoms around the world; and works with leading brands to connect them with audiences they value. From award-winning technology to the[highest-grossing unrated film in U.S. history](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=3829636949&u=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.proofpoint.com%2Fv2%2Furl%3Fu%3Dhttps-3A__www.boxofficemojo.com_release_rl2221441025%26d%3DDwMFaQ%26c%3DeuGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM%26r%3DB2PNf5C_2XADP6dsTgnr53OvDOYVOPW2rehMq7In2oQ%26m%3D1qE6TsvVFs0moFpQ1oHkDO5J1QdYGaC82jEdPf7iiDru9zQol6LbgKvmK12XCNeA%26s%3DH2-gR0tVdDs9908LbD89uxQYb1GF8meDp04NNOWUHAw%26e%3D&a=highest-grossing+unrated+film+in+U.S.+history) , Cineverse has created a playbook that marries tech and content to redefine the next era of entertainment. For more information, visit[cineverse.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784500-1&h=648481794&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcineverse.com%2F&a=cineverse.com) .
